audit.scope: Fixed authored dress material only. layerSeparation.scope: Finite horizontal radial cuts through actual main-cloth and underlayer triangles at four covered heights, front/back/sides/diagonals. Underlayer outer wall must precede main inner wall. Strict triangle-ray misses remain separate unscored reader observations; paired small probes, when recorded, are additional evidence and do not replace nominal rays. The intentionally visible lower cream hem and fixed waist overlap are excluded. No continuous global layer or cloth-contact guarantee.

modelDeclaredPassagesRechecked.scope: Producer-authored route definitions re-intersected with actual world triangles; additional finite cases, not additional distinct tests.

independentAttachments.scope: Each authored witness is independently checked against actual world triangles with three parity directions and positive surface clearance. These finite shared solids do not establish strength or continuous cloth attachment.

liningPairDistances.scope: Only the listed outer/inner pairs are checked against actual vertices; no global minimum material thickness.
